metadata.description: omp plugins by Daniel Morris: status readouts, themes, routing, cluster gates and review/unblock roles

plugins.name: effort
plugins.description: Show the thinking effort (reasoning level) in the status area, including for local engines whose built-in readout stays blank.

plugins.name: omarchy-theme
plugins.description: Derive omp's TUI theme from the current Omarchy theme colors and follow theme changes live.

plugins.name: thermal-gate
plugins.description: Hold requests to a hot DGX Spark cluster until it cools, and refuse new Sparks subagents while Machinist is busy.

plugins.name: jev-router
plugins.description: Route each turn to a model, and each delegated task to an agent, using a Jev capability classification plus live provider quota.

plugins.name: roles
plugins.description: pr-reviewer (read-only PR/branch review on the review role) and unblocker (fresh-eyes help after 30+ minutes going in circles, on the unblock role).
